cases.name: valid-yaml
cases.rule: replace only the base vector publisher fingerprint
cases.payload:
apiVersion: ricevanta.io/v1alpha1
kind: Extension
metadata:
  id: com.example.rules
  version: 1.2.0
  publisher:
    name: Example Security
    key: sha256:56475aa75463474c0285df5dbf2bcab73da651358839e9b77481b2eab107708c
  license: Apache-2.0
  source: https://example.com/rules
spec:
  requires:
    content:
    - ext.ricevanta.io/content/v1
  components:
  - name: rules
    kind: content
    interface: ext.ricevanta.io/content/v1
    files:
    - content/rules.yaml
    format: classification
    file: content/rules.yaml
    capabilities: {}
files:
- path: content/rules.yaml
  sha256: ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad
  size: 3
